title: Miami weekend nightlife guide, starting with the closest thing to free
igCaption:
Cold air, late nights, and a burger run.

Sources: Miami New Times, Secret Miami, Eventbrite

#MiamiEvents #MiamiNightlife #Wynwood #SouthFlorida

scenes.text: What’s actually worth doing this weekend, starting with the cold front and ending after three in the morning?
Start with the weather. A cold front moves in Friday night, with Miami around fifty-nine degrees. Saturday stays sunny near seventy-three. We have not dipped below sixty since March twenty-second.
scenes.caption: Start with the weather. A cold front moves in Friday night, with Miami around 59°. Saturday stays sunny near 73°. We have not dipped below 60° since March 22.

scenes.text: For a cheap bite before drinks, Skinny Louie has official Burger Shot menus at participating Florida locations through December thirty-first. The Burger Shot Single is eight ninety-nine, and the Bleeder Triple is fifteen forty-nine.
scenes.caption: For a cheap bite before drinks, Skinny Louie has official Burger Shot menus at participating Florida locations through Dec. 31. The Burger Shot Single is $8.99, and the Bleeder Triple is $15.49.

scenes.text: Keep it in Wynwood if you want pizza before the bars. Francesco Martucci at ten Northeast Twenty-Seventh Street was named Florida’s pick by Food & Wine, and ranked number twenty-seven in the world for twenty twenty-six. If you're at Martucci's, NEAR shows who else grabbed pizza before the bars.
scenes.caption: Keep it in Wynwood if you want pizza before the bars. Francesco Martucci at 10 NE 27th St. was named Florida’s pick by Food & Wine, and ranked No. 27 in the world for 2026. If you're at Martucci's, NEAR shows who else grabbed pizza before the bars.

scenes.text: The late-night pick is Desi Rave, billed as the Miami Friendsgiving Experience. Eventbrite lists it for Friday, November twenty-seventh, from ten at night to three in the morning. That is a five-hour night.
scenes.caption: The late-night pick is Desi Rave, billed as the Miami Friendsgiving Experience. Eventbrite lists it for Friday, Nov. 27, from 10 PM to 3 AM. That is a 5-hour night.

scenes.text: Which one are you doing, and what should make next weekend’s list? Funny how you can spend a whole Miami night passing the same faces and never learn their names, which is exactly the kind of gap the NEAR app fills.
